title: Right cancellation for right-anodyne monomorphisms
statement: Use simplicial sets and simplicial maps of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and right anodyne maps of [def-coef-infinity-right-anodyne], in any fixed containing universe. Let $f:A\hookrightarrow B$ and $g:B\hookrightarrow C$ be degreewise injective simplicial maps. Assume that $f$ is right anodyne. Then $g$ is right anodyne if and only if $g\circ f$ is right anodyne. No quasicategory or Kan hypothesis is imposed on $A,B,C$.

source.place: Corollary 4.1.10, printed p.140 (PDF p.155, zero-based). Read online 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this one-sided simplicial cancellation theorem.
